origin: Independent producer block requested through19:05UTC. This records two construction directions examined before any writer implementation. It is not a retrospective repair or a complete new selected model.

quantity_direction.idea: Write a learned material/unit stem with a productive halving, doubling or fraction construction, preserving the difference between an amount, an input portion and a changed product.
quantity_direction.duplicate_boundary: Halving iteration and scope-dependent fractions already have concrete primary proposals. A new suffix alphabet alone would not provide a materially new mechanism.

primaries.scope: The whole-to-half-to-quarter account lacks whole-passage quantity lineage. A synthetic quarter calculation alone is explicitly insufficient; its native hypotheses are not reused.

The common-bar fraction grammar already supplies a concrete nonlinear composition law and complete historical examples. Its spatial syntax and target serialization remain distinct obligations. No fresh historical page was opened here.

Both fixed full two-recipe quantity writers are closed. Their sole QD1 source occurrence conflicts with two occurrences in every numerically compatible literal target branch. Neither assigning another quantity nor repairing a quantity namespace is permitted. This does not reject every possible quantity notation.

quantity_direction.decision: No new fraction card or numerical demonstration; changing marker spellings would repeat an already concrete mechanism.

distributed_root_pattern_direction.human_purpose: Learn one short ordered root for a concept, then form grammatical relatives by one recurring interleaving rule. Derived whole words would not need separate semantic dictionary entries. This is a modern teaching reconstruction; no historical language or Voynich alphabet is selected.
distributed_root_pattern_direction.specific_kernel_considered: Partition the22working units into18 root units, three distinct grammatical melody units and one escape/control unit. A learned root c1...cn of length1..3 produces the inflected word c1 v c2 v ... cn v, where the same chosen melody v marks the declared grammatical operation. Bare reference roots would also be length1..3. This short-root restriction is an explicit proposed teaching limit, not a natural-language universal.
distributed_root_pattern_direction.teaching_example_only: Let the artificial root [p,t,k] have learned relation COVER and [d,l]/[s,n] identify Ada/the bowl. A prospective positive melody a gives [p,a,t,a,k,a]; a distinct negative melody e gives [p,e,t,e,k,e]. With overt sentence delimitation, the intended contrast is 'Ada covers the bowl' versus 'Ada does not cover the bowl'. None of these working forms is a native value. Full argument/list, modal and physical rules were not frozen, so this is a kernel illustration rather than a finished writer or manual-readback claim.
distributed_root_pattern_direction.elementary_obstruction: Every six-unit inflected output of this exact kernel repeats the same melody at positions2,4,6. The already supplied exact whole qokedy consists of six different working units. No global bijection changes either equality partition, so that whole form cannot be a six-unit derived word of this kernel.
distributed_root_pattern_direction.whole_writer_qualification: This is first a derived-word-class exclusion, not an exclusion of every possible complete root-and-pattern writer. A whole writer would have to say whether qokedy could instead be an explicitly paid other class. With the stated primitive-root maximum3 it cannot be a bare primitive root. A proposed literal route with the same nonempty opening/closing escape unit at both ends also could not produce an all-distinct six-unit whole. These extra framing rules were not adopted merely to strengthen an exclusion; they remain explicitly conditional alternatives. An unrestricted free long-root class would evade this local statement but surrender the proposed restriction that long learned forms be productively built.
distributed_root_pattern_direction.triple_scope: If using a known whole-word triple to exclude continuation-fragment reinterpretation, the fixed physical carrier must first make its continuation words visible and distinguishable. No complete physical triple proof is claimed here before such a carrier exists. No new triple records, word profiles or raw data were queried.
distributed_root_pattern_direction.decision: Stop this narrow uniform-melody kernel before expanding a full table. Do not add a second melody per slot, enlarge the primitive-root limit or create an exception after this known countercase and then call it the same model. No new RAW card, statistical trial or universal rejection of distributed morphology follows.

other_primaries_and_scope.scope: These shared-root/terminal-role prefix-suffix writers and their complete form-pattern search were actually run. The registered unresolved stop remains; no new round of that search is proposed. They did not establish or eliminate the uniform internal-melody kernel considered here.

Reusable owner/action realization frames already compressed an inherited German rendering. Its nine old guessed root values are not lexical facts. The proposed next context-frame step was executed in569 and later repeats/attachments in574/578/579, as lookup shows; it is not an unexecuted new idea.

Fixed vowel-deleted source controls failed. Deleting vowels from ordinary source text differs from deriving a word with a meaningful internal pattern. Neither a revival of193 nor a source-language identification follows.

other_primaries_and_scope.id: B6 productive stems / GDT1175 and later parser limits
other_primaries_and_scope.scope: Productive learned roots, unary/binary constructors, literal unknown words and explicit grammar are already complete teaching mechanisms. Their limited source transfer and later fixed-parser countercases remain; another operator label is not new.

Existing topic/property/action, state/become/cause, carried-participant, measured-material and comparison contracts remain unchanged. The new block neither merges their unpaid pieces nor repairs their fixed carrier obstructions. A derived family must yield more than freely relearning every long form.

limits: No claim that all simple productive writing is exhausted. No native gloss, new source/image, data count, encoder, fitted alphabet, changed route/ledger/state or root result inspection. Bounded search/duplicate navigation is not an absence proof. The quantity and uniform-melody directions are retained as precise design limits instead of quota additions.
